user.title: Connect your Freebox
user.description:
Freebox HA {version}.

Local box address. Only public /api_version metadata uses HTTP. Pairing and all data use verified HTTPS. The default local HTTPS port is 443.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: The token was revoked. A new authorization must be accepted on the Freebox screen.

progress.pairing: Authorize “Freebox HA” on your Freebox screen. This can take up to two minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the local address, HTTPS and certificate.
error.tls_certificate_error: The HTTPS certificate could not be verified. Check the Home Assistant clock and install the latest Freebox HA version.
error.tls_handshake_error: The HTTPS handshake failed. Check the local HTTPS port and the Freebox firmware.
error.connection_timeout: The Freebox did not respond in time. Check that Home Assistant can reach its local address.
error.connection_refused: The local HTTPS port refused the connection. Check the port; 443 is the default.
error.https_unavailable: This Freebox reports that HTTPS is unavailable.
error.invalid_api_version: The response to /api_version is invalid or incomplete. Check the local box address.
error.apps_denied: Freebox OS refuses new application authorizations. Allow applications in its access settings.
error.wrong_freebox: The Freebox identity changed between discovery and the verified HTTPS connection.
error.invalid_request: Freebox rejected the authorization parameters. Update Freebox HA and check the pairing error in Home Assistant logs.
error.new_apps_denied: Freebox OS has disabled authorization of new applications. Enable it in its access settings.
error.denied_from_external_ip: Freebox considers this request remote. Home Assistant must access it from the local network to pair.
error.ratelimited: Freebox temporarily limits authorization requests. Wait before retrying.
error.internal_error: Freebox reported an internal authorization error. Check its firmware and retry later.

abort.wrong_freebox: The Freebox identity does not match.
abort.denied: Authorization was denied on the Freebox.
abort.pairing_failed: Pairing timed out or was interrupted. Try again.

categories.title: Data collection
categories.description: Denied endpoints are skipped and reported in diagnostics. No active scans are performed. Downloads and parental controls may require additional Freebox OS permissions. Only essential entities are enabled by default. Disabled sensors can be enabled individually from their device. Name grouping merges LAN/Wi-Fi identities and retains their MAC aliases.

data.interval_wifi_environment: Cached Wi-Fi channel usage and neighbors

alerts.title: Events and alerts
alerts.description: Two fresh observations are always required. FTTH power is documented in hundredths of dBm: change the source unit only after verifying your firmware. Wi-Fi signal is documented as attenuation in dB. Known Wi-Fi clients use radio associations instead of delayed LAN status; incomplete radio coverage makes presence unavailable.

privacy.title: Privacy and diagnostics
privacy.description: JSON diagnostics never include raw API responses. Temporary logging only records counts, without names, addresses or tokens. HA backups contain the token and local inventory: protect them.

data.expose_identity: Expose addresses and names in entities
data.event_identity: Include MAC and name in events

capabilities.title: API capabilities

essential.title: Essential profile
essential.description: Enable only Internet, fibre, presence, Wi-Fi, Ethernet and temperatures. One presence tracker is enabled per device; same-name identities are grouped. Other families and detailed sensors are optional. Superseded grouped entities are replaced by the retained device: update automations that used them. Entities manually disabled stay disabled.
